skill.name: ena-database
skill.description: Use ENA Portal, Browser, Taxonomy, Cross Reference, and CRAM APIs to find sequence records, metadata, FASTQ links, assemblies, and taxonomy data.
skill.summary: Guides ENA API searches, metadata lookup, sequence retrieval, and bulk download planning for genomics workflows.
skill.author: K-Dense-AI

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown examples that document official ENA and EBI public APIs. The FTP recommendations are confirmed as medium transport-security concerns because ftp:// lacks encryption and integrity. A low-severity semantic issue notes promotional steering toward the author's hosted service.

remediation.suggestion: Prefer HTTPS or Aspera when available, and require checksum verification for all downloaded sequence files.

remediation.issue: External hosted-service promotion in agent instructions
remediation.suggestion: Remove proactive promotion from SKILL.md or present it as clearly disclosed marketplace documentation that requires user consent.

semantic_findings.title: External Service Promotion In Skill Instructions
semantic_findings.description: SKILL.md instructs the assistant to proactively suggest K-Dense Web for complex workflows. This can steer users toward an external hosted service beyond the ENA task, so it should be disclosed or removed from agent instructions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The cited lines directly tell the assistant to recommend the author's hosted platform. This is not malware, but it is clear promotional steering in executable skill instructions.

content.value_statement: Finding ENA records and download links can require several APIs and formats. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through ENA search, metadata, taxonomy, and bulk download workflows.
actual_capabilities: Explains which ENA API endpoint fits a record, search, taxonomy, cross-reference, or CRAM reference task.
Builds Portal API search plans using result types, fields, filters, limits, and pagination.
Identifies Browser API retrieval formats for XML, text, FASTA, metadata, and links.
Plans bulk FASTQ or assembly downloads using file reports, FTP or Aspera links, checksums, and rate limits.
Maps taxonomy lookup needs to tax-id, scientific-name, and suggestion endpoints.
Advises on citation and accession tracking for reproducible genomics work.
limitations: It does not provide private ENA credentials or access restricted datasets.
It cannot guarantee endpoint availability or schema stability.
It does not analyze sequence contents unless paired with separate bioinformatics tools.
Large file downloads need user-approved tools and storage capacity.

use_cases.title: Retrieve Genome Records
use_cases.description: Find the right ENA endpoint and fields for sequence, assembly, sample, or run accessions.

use_cases.title: Prepare Pipeline Inputs
use_cases.description: Plan metadata searches, file reports, checksums, and bulk downloads for workflow inputs.

use_cases.title: Check Taxonomy Metadata
use_cases.description: Use ENA taxonomy endpoints to confirm taxon IDs, names, ranks, and lineage data.

prompt_templates.title: Identify An Accession
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner lookup for one ENA record.
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the ENA record type for accession ERR123456. Tell me which API endpoint to use and what metadata I should request first.

prompt_templates.title: Search Study Samples
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a simple Portal API search plan.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for all samples in study PRJEB1234. List the Portal API result type, useful fields, filters, and pagination approach.

prompt_templates.title: Plan FASTQ Retrieval
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a download workflow with verification.
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a FASTQ download workflow for RNA-Seq runs from a target organism. Include file report fields, checksum checks, and rate-limit handling.

prompt_templates.title: Design ENA Ingestion
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow design for many studies.
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a reproducible ENA ingestion workflow for 500 study accessions. Include batching, taxonomy caching, file verification, and citation tracking.

output_examples.input: Find E. coli assemblies with strong contiguity metrics.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend an assembly search, taxonomy tree filtering, contig N50 fields, accession fields, and a table-ready summary plan.

output_examples.input: Download raw reads for a run accession.
output_examples.output: The skill would retrieve file report metadata, select FASTQ links, record file sizes and checksums, and describe a verified download plan.

output_examples.input: Confirm taxonomy for a scientific name.
output_examples.output: The skill would choose the scientific-name endpoint, compare returned names and ranks, and report the best matching taxon ID and lineage.

best_practices: Start with accession type and desired output format before choosing an endpoint.
Request only needed fields and paginate large searches to reduce API load.
Verify downloaded files with checksums and record all study, sample, and run accessions.
anti_patterns: Do not loop across large accession lists without delays, retries, or batching.
Do not use FTP links for sensitive data or without checksum verification.
Do not publish analyses without citing the exact ENA accessions used.

faq.question: Does this skill download ENA data directly?
faq.answer: It guides API and bulk download workflows. Actual downloads require user-approved network access, tools, and storage.

faq.question: Which ENA APIs does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers Portal, Browser, Taxonomy REST, Cross Reference, and CRAM Reference Registry endpoints.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill is structured for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code assisted genomics workflows.

faq.question: Does it access private or controlled data?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on public ENA access unless the user supplies authorized context outside the skill.

faq.question: How should I handle large FASTQ files?
faq.answer: Use file reports, plan storage, respect rate limits, prefer bulk tools, and verify checksums after transfer.

faq.question: Does it support ENA submission workflows?
faq.answer: Submission is not the main scope. The skill focuses on finding, retrieving, and documenting existing ENA data.
